columns.name: Date_Key
columns.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) in SAST timezone

columns.name: Global_Posts_Used
columns.description: Total posts dispatched across all campaigns today

columns.name: Last_Updated_At
columns.description: ISO timestamp of last counter increment

counter_persistence.init_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Daily_Post_Counters (Date_Key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, Global_Posts_Used INTEGER DEFAULT 0, Campaign_Counters_JSON TEXT DEFAULT '{}', Last_Updated_At TEXT);

reset_schedule.fallback_mechanism: Rolling 24-hour window from first post of the day if cron fails

global_cap_breach.log_format: [RATE_LIMITER_BREACH] Global cap exceeded (6/6 used). Dispatch request silently dropped.

per_campaign_cap_breach.log_format: [RATE_LIMITER_BREACH] Campaign {campaign_id} exceeded 3/3 daily cap. Queued for next available slot.

escalation_threshold.escalation_log_format: [SECURITY_ALERT] Rate limiter breached 5+ times consecutively. Manual audit required.

integration_points.ui_status_indicator: Tab 05 Calendar // Bounty Governor Status Badge

operational_notes.stealth_compliance: All counters and breach logs are silent. No external API calls or user-facing alerts unless escalation threshold is met.
operational_notes.disk_persistence: SQLite database ensures counter state survives daemon restarts and system reboots.
operational_notes.zero_state_init: If rate_limiter.db does not exist on boot, Auto_Bounty_Engine.js will auto-initialize the schema on first dispatch attempt.
operational_notes.audit_trail: All counter increments and breach events are logged to active_telemetry.md with ISO timestamps for forensic review.
